title: Give a supporting statement with each payment claim
what: As a head contractor, serve each payment claim on the principal with a supporting statement (declaring that subcontractors have been paid).

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry Security of Payment Act 1999 (NSW)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Security of Payment Act 1999 (NSW)

sources.quote: A head contractor must not serve a payment claim on the principal unless the claim is accompanied by a supporting statement that indicates that it relates to that payment claim
